name: Grow Up and Play
tagline: Playful spaces for children, families, and learning in nature
description: Grow Up and Play combines child-led discovery, outdoor education, and community play to help young people develop confidence, creativity, and ecological awareness.
contentSubHeading: Healthy growth through play and outdoor learning

branchDonations.name: Playsets and Climbing Structures
branchDonations.description: Donate wooden or metal playsets, climbing frames, slides, and swings so children can explore freely in safe outdoor environments.

branchDonations.name: Art and Craft Supplies
branchDonations.description: Contribute paint, clay, fabric, paper, and other art materials so children can express themselves and build creative confidence.

branchDonations.name: Children's Books
branchDonations.short: Stories that spark curiosity and wonder
branchDonations.description: Donate gently used children's books — especially nature, science, and storytelling titles that encourage reading and imagination.

branchDonations.name: Children's Garden Kits
branchDonations.description: Support child-led garden projects with seed kits, small tools, pots, and soil so every child can experience the joy of growing their own food.

branchDonations.name: Outdoor Gear
branchDonations.short: Rain boots, hats, and adventure clothes
branchDonations.description: Give gently used rain gear, sturdy shoes, sun hats, and outdoor clothing so no child misses a session due to weather or wardrobe.

branchDonations.name: Program Scholarships
branchDonations.short: Access for every child regardless of income
branchDonations.description: Contribute to our scholarship fund so families facing financial barriers can still enroll their children in Grow Up and Play programs.

branchFeatures.description: We create safe, adventurous outdoor spaces that invite exploration, storytelling, and creative movement.
Hands-on projects teach skills in gardening, building, cooking, and nature connection while keeping children engaged and inspired.
Parents and caregivers join the journey so play becomes a way to deepen relationships, support each other, and share resources.

missionTitle: Grow curious hearts and resilient learners
missionText1: This branch gives children the freedom to learn outdoors and the space to build confidence through play that feels meaningful and connected.
missionText2: We support neighborhoods that want better ways for kids and adults to grow together without the pressure of screens or over-scheduled lives.
